# Field test — September 2026

The rover nearly went tipping sideways on a steep grassy bank; on gravel slopes it slid but stayed upright.

Follow-up: the throttle clamp in [[rover/docs/attitude-limiter]] now kicks in earlier. Odometry also over-reported distance on wet grass ([[RV-007-odometry-slip]]).
